description: Subdivion du quadrillage DFCI 2 x 2 km - Isère is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. Subdivision of the 2kmx2km grid used for monitoring and fighting forest fires. This subdivision aims at a more precise location of the lights. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Subdivision of the DFCI grid 2 x 2 km - Isère" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include foret DFCI, ISERE. The listing shows 2019-07-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
